caption:
2 Minute Protein Lava Cake
microwave recipe | high protein | no fuss recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 52 | F: 17 | P: 35
Calories: 443 per serving 
Serves 1

Ingredients
1 scoop chocolate protein 
1 banana 
1 egg
1/4 tsp baking powder (2 grams) 
1 tsp monkfruit sweetener, might not be needed if your protein flavour is good! 
2-3 tbsp milk to get the desired consistency, you can use more if you need to ( sometimes protein powder absorbs alot of liquid) 
1 small block of chocolate, i used 70% sugar free but use any chocolate you want, calories wont vary that much - if you skip the chocolate you lessen the carbs and fats significantly and reduce the overall calories by 140 approx. 

Method
add all the ingredients to a blender sans chocolate and mix well
add to a mug and add the chocolate in the centre covering it with some mix 
microwave for 2 minutes , it could take 30-45 seconds more depending on the strenght of your microwave and enjoy :)
